title: The Computer Chronicles - Hypercard (1987)
summary: A 1987 episode of The Computer Chronicles on Apple's HyperCard, showing users building their own applications. Gary Kildall appears and Bill Atkinson discusses the program, with credit given to earlier influences.
why: HN points to it as a period view of HyperCard and a source for its history and influences.

quote.text: Years ago I stumbled on this (wonderfully dorky) episode of Computer Chronicles, that focuses on HyperCard
